_: The woods (forest.gd; docs/TUNING.md). near: within this distance of the camera (world units) trees are drawn in full, with shadows (a block of woods switches as one); mid: out to this distance the middle batch, without shadows; the far batch beyond. map: at map zoom, past from (world units), the far batch again with each tree grown by grow [across, up] about its foot, so a wood reads as one canopy (02-realm), not dots. woods: where trees stand, by Freeciv's tile under the land's warped biome line (vegetation.gd _woodland): jitter (a clump's wander off its terrain's grid, a share of its gap), size [least, most] (a tree's scale on its kind's height), shore_gap (no tree within this height of the beach's top, ground.json beach.top: on the land's own shore line, not a fixed height, which left the low coastal woods bare: 0.15 dropped every tree on half the forest tiles of a lowland realm), pine_above (pine likelier above this height); tiles.<Freeciv terrain>: gap (game units between clumps), clump [least, most] trees, r (a clump's reach), pine (the share of pine), undergrowth (the chance of a bush under a clump). cover: the ground cover's files by role (bush, grass, rock; under assets/; bush, grass and rock from the nature set (rock: nt_rock_a 1.2 m and nt_rock_b 2.5 m boulders), nt_bush 1.6 m and nt_grass_clump 0.5 m at scale 1, their leaves turning with the season). cover_per_tile: how many of each role a tile of that terrain holds. Densities from the look audit's spec (2026-11-12, read off 01-town and 03-army, estimates): inside a wood trunks 5-6 m apart, 3-4 trees per 100 m2 (woods_probe measures it over the forest tiles); copses of 3-7 25-40 m apart outside woods. Grassland and plains hold copses 60-100 m apart (the look audit: never a screen of plain grass away from towns; a town's own land is its fields and hedges).
